51574.author: fwyzard
51574.body:
#### PR description:

Extend `cudaComputeCapabilities` and `rocmComputeCapabilities` to print device UUIDs.

`cudaComputeCapabilities -u` and `rocmComputeCapabilities -u` print the UUIDs instead of the device indices:
```
$ cudaComputeCapabilities -u
MIG-1f292bf8-f63f-570f-a866-efaab3ceb50a     9.0    NVIDIA H100 NVL MIG 3g.47gb
```
```
$ rocmComputeCapabilities -u
GPU-5ab32c7e97ef5251    gfx942:sramecc+:xnack+    AMD Instinct MI300X
```

`cudaComputeCapabilities -v` also prints the UUID as an extra field:
```
$ cudaComputeCapabilities -v
   0     9.0    NVIDIA H100 NVL MIG 3g.47gb
    PCI device id:                                                 0000:61:00.0
    UUID:                              MIG-1f292bf8-f63f-570f-a866-efaab3ceb50a
    integrated:                                                              no
    total global memory:                                              47488 MiB
    ...
```

For NVIDIA GPUs, use NVML to resolve binary UUIDs to GPU UUIDs (_e.g._ `GPU-b803e676-f4b3-4bc2-d08e-05cefd5812ae`) or MIG UUIDs (_e.g._ `MIG-1f292bf8-f63f-570f-a866-efaab3ceb50a`).

#### PR validation:

None.


### Backport status:

Backport of #51559 to CMSSW 17.x for Run 3 activities.
51574.title: [17.0] Add flag to print GPU UUIDs

Backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51451

#### PR description:

Fix: parameters in `ElectronSeedFitter` and convert them to actual module parameters. The old parameter of 0.2 used for `originRBound` / `originRadius` was from a CMSSW_14 HLT menu and caused degradation in egamma seeding efficiency reported and discussed in https://its.cern.ch/jira/browse/CMSHLT-3746. This PR fixes the performance, as also reported in https://its.cern.ch/jira/browse/CMSHLT-3746
